possible_dreams_eugenio_mininni_mixkit.windowNotes: Four ~5.5 s piano phrases, then the full strings/ensemble enters at 22.059 s. Even from the first note (0.673 s) the lift falls at 21.39 s, 0.6 s before the requested zone. The phrase's cadence chord then lands at 40.681 s (= 40.0 s in the window) and decays until 43.5 s. No 40 s window gets both the lift into 22-28 s and an end on the resolution: either fade over the climax or let the film run about 3 s longer.

a_long_way_sergepavkinmusic_pixabay.attributionText: Music by Sergii Pavkin from Pixabay
a_long_way_sergepavkinmusic_pixabay.windowNotes: Electronic / ambient build in 8.0 s cells, each opened by a low impact (8.057, 16.068, 24.056, 40.031, 56.053 s). The window starts on the 16.068 hit and ends exactly before the 56.053 hit; the lift at 40.031 brings in the rhythmic layer. The 80.1 BPM grid follows the dotted arpeggio pulse. The exact 8.0 s impact spacing suggests the composition runs at 120 BPM (16 beats per cell), but that is an inference, so use the impact times for big cuts.
